method: Every fourth timeout terminal state, cold solver cache,400 native steps with constant XML position-actuator controls. Policy queried once from restored observations; alternatives hold current arm joints, optionally reduce gripper closure to2mm. CPU and GPU receive identical local state/controls and matched per-world randomized friction from this probe. Original evaluation friction was not saved in its trace; this probe samples the registered distribution. No policy training, no first-episode success evaluation; steady-control intervention only.
